selfreview.verification: verify.py --nonretail PASS with zero failures and warnings; own-date render completed.
selfreview.source_discipline: Only current-date exclusions/feed/card plus permitted docs/reference opened. Excluded selected current IDs and additional root advisory n2520; no six-seat Model Y details used. Every concrete claim checked against its own exact headline and semantic source window.
selfreview.release_status: New China and Poland manufacturing commentary, Volkswagen possible closure, local Sept2 trading and crypto Sept2 daily candle treated as available; old completed earnings remain actual. Pending Fed, USTR, BoE capital publication and Tesla robotaxi events stay conditional. Harris headline remains a preview, not a completed statement or deal outcome.
selfreview.numbers: Official Treasury Aug30 yields percent and changes/spreads bps; US listed instruments Aug30, local exchanges instrument-specific Sept2; crypto preceding completed Sept2 UTC day. All numeric values exact own card/headline same paragraph, currency/index/PMI units and horizons explicit. No numeric spot FX, restricted levels or split-incompatible triggers.
selfreview.claims: No invented holdings, institutional purchases, social posts, measured ownership or article-body details. Bond flows and fund close identify actual reported capital actions; buyback plans remain authorisations, price changes remain performance. Clinical analysis and regulatory filings do not imply approval or immediate sales.
selfreview.consistency: 36 blocks/136 paragraphs; broad China and Poland, ASML/TSMC in SOXX, four instrument themes, four genuinely pending conditional scenarios, six single-name ticker catalysts. Quality-first US/EU/JP/AU/PL stance, cautious China/autos, selective grids/health/staples constructive. No named country-ETF sector composition asserted.
selfreview.retail: No retail content read or changed; empty placeholders retained, all nonretail citations at most three uses.
selfreview.self_review_limits: Author self-review only, not independent editorial acceptance.
